concept: A high-speed train viewed from above, mid-collision, with two parallel tracks converging at a violent angle. The front cars are crumpled and twisted metal, fragmenting into jagged shards. The scene is rendered in bold, blocky shapes with sharp geometric breaks. Dark steel grays and blacks dominate, with flashes of emergency red cutting through. The composition is symmetrical but violently asymmetrical at the collision point, suggesting sudden chaos within order. A modernist, almost cubist interpretation of mechanical failure. Harsh lighting, no softness.
explanation: The Spanish train crash dominates today's news in human cost and immediacy—68 dead, survivors traumatized, an inexplicable error at the heart of a system meant to be reliable. While other stories speak to political instability, migration, health crises, and historical reckoning, nothing matches the visceral shock of sudden industrial catastrophe. The crash represents a collapse of trust in technology and safety, a moment where systems designed to protect instead destroyed.

headlines.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
headlines.summary: The crash, between a moving train and another that was stopped further up the track, was caused by an "inexplicable" error, the transport minister said.

headlines.title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
headlines.summary: Survivors of the train crash in Spain have spoken of their shock, panic and anger at the accident in Toledo province on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
headlines.summary: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

headlines.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
headlines.summary: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

headlines.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
headlines.summary: With 85% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.

headlines.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at German wildlife park
headlines.summary: The eight-year-old was in an enclosure with other children and a staff member when she was attacked.

headlines.title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
headlines.summary: The Villa Vie Odyssey suspended its voyage and is working with passengers on "temporary living arrangements".

headlines.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
headlines.summary: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.

headlines.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
headlines.summary: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

headlines.title: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
headlines.summary: The energy minister described it as a "major milestone" for the East African nation.

headlines.title: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
headlines.summary: No official reason has been given for postponing next month’s hearing to May 2027, the family says.

headlines.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
